title: Deep Forest Bloom
body:
Syntax: perform deep forest bloom <target>

Description: A Wood Release attack that strikes one target. A drained target loses Chakra over time.  Requires Wood Release and its revealed chakra natures, without a clan bloodline. Base damage: 1509-1789. 35% chance to inflict drained. Unlocks at level 70. Costs 78 Chakra and 0 Stamina; 24 second cooldown.

Date: 2026-09-27
